scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The infinite claim is proved directly and finite exhaustive checks are only consistency evidence. The foundational 2010 article has month/year bibliographic evidence but no inspected day-resolved public date; 2015-03-05 is the earliest day-resolved public date verified among the inspected sources, avoiding an invented day.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Restricted to generalized windmills K_1 join rK_m with r>=2 and m>=2. The friendship scalar m=2 is prior work. General block-graph algorithms provide instance-wise minima but not the all-set formula proved here.

title: Open locating-dominating sets of generalized windmill graphs
